title: An open containing the closed fiber of a proper scheme over a complete base is everything
statement: Let A be a commutative ring complete for an ideal I [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let f : Y → Spec A [def-weil-affine-spectrum] and g : X → Y be scheme morphisms with g followed by f proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let W be an open subset of X containing g⁻¹(image(Y ×_A Spec(A/I) → Y)) [def-pc-base-change, def-pc-fibre-product]. Then W = X.

proof.text: Set h = g followed by f. The complement C of W is closed, so properness makes h(C) closed in Spec A. Write it as V(K). If x belongs to C, then K is contained in the prime ideal h(x), which is contained in a maximal ideal m. Thus m belongs to V(K), so m = h(t) for some t in C.

Completeness gives I ≤ jacobson(0) ≤ m. The range of Spec(A/I) → Spec A is V(I), by range_comap_of_surjective and Ideal.mk_ker; Scheme.Pullback.range_fst says that the range of Y_0 → Y is f⁻¹(V(I)). Hence g(t) lies in that range. The containment hypothesis puts t in W, contradicting t in C. Thus W = X.

mathlib_searches.query: An open subscheme containing the closed fiber of a proper scheme over an adically complete ring is the whole scheme
proper scheme over complete ring open subset containing special fiber equals whole scheme

lean.statement:
theorem proper_closed_fiber_open_eq_top
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [IsAdicComplete I A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A)) (g : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper (g ≫ f)] (W : X.Opens)
    (hW : (g : X → Y) ⁻¹' Set.range
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))) : _ → _) ⊆
        (W : Set X)) : W = ⊤
